Coalossal

Rock Fire

Galar · Generation 8

Coalossal is a Rock/Fire-type Coal Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 2.8 m tall and weighs 310.5 kg. It evolves from Carkol. Its highest base stat is Defense (120), with a base stat total of 510.
